newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy govt bill for 3rd mobile phone licence ready.
newsitem.headline: Italy govt bill for 3rd mobile phone licence ready.

text.p: The Italian Posts ministry has finalised a bill setting out the details for a tender for Italy's third mobile phone operating licence.
Ministry undersecretary Michele Lauria said in a statement the measure would be examined by the cabinet "as soon as possible" and that the tender could take place around the end of this year.
Companies from both Italy and other European Union members will be allowed to bid for the licence.
The two existing operators are Telecom Italia Mobile and Omnitel-Pronto-Italia, controlled by Olivetti.

Mediaset, the recently floated television and advertising arm of Silvio Berlusconi's Fininvest SpA empire, has already said it will be a bidder in partnership with the British Telecommunications Plc and Italian state-owned bank BNL's Albacom joint venture.
